scientific_integrity: Proof and all normalizations are explicit; exact polynomial arithmetic verifies bandwidths 1 through 12, not the universal quantifiers. Independent validation has not occurred.

title: Exact singular spectrum of half-turn restriction on \(SO(3)\)
